about: A fictional person's voice journal, 2025-11-01 to 2026-10-31. Everything is invented. Used to evaluate search in tällmi; never real data.
narrator: Kai, 34, product designer at a Munich startup called Nordwerk. Thinks out loud, German with English mixed in (work jargon, whole English sentences sometimes). Lives in Munich-Giesing.

topics.person:lea: Lea, his girlfriend (physiotherapist). Relationship, dates, conflicts, moving in together.
topics.person:anna: Anna, his older sister in Regensburg. Pregnant from summer, baby (Mila) born in October.
topics.person:mama: His mother (he calls her Mama or Mutti), lives in Regensburg, phone calls, worries about him.
topics.person:oma: His grandmother Oma Gerti, 89. Falls in December, hospital, rehab, recovers slowly.
topics.person:tobi: Tobi, best friend since school. Beers, football, Tobi's 35th birthday party in August.
topics.person:sven: Sven, his team lead at Nordwerk. Tension, deadlines, a hard feedback talk, later better.
topics.person:dr-weber: Dr. Weber, his therapist from February on. Sessions, homework, insights he reports in his own words.
topics.place:isar: Walks, runs and evenings at the Isar river.
topics.place:office: The Nordwerk office, open space, meetings, the coffee machine.
topics.place:flat-giesing: His old flat in Giesing (until June): the broken heating, the landlord Herr Kraus.
topics.place:new-flat: The new flat in Haidhausen with Lea from July: boxes, furniture, balcony.
topics.place:regensburg: His home town, family visits, Christmas there.
topics.place:lisbon: Holiday in Lisbon with Lea in July.
topics.place:alps: Day hikes in the Alps, the Benediktenwand, Kampenwand.
topics.work:launch: The big product launch of the Nordwerk app in March: prep, crunch, launch day, aftermath.
topics.work:stress: Overload, overtime, Slack at night, feeling behind.
topics.work:salary: Preparing and having a salary negotiation in August.
topics.work:ai-worries: Worry whether AI tools will make designers obsolete; using AI at work.
topics.health:sleep: Bad sleep, waking at 4am, tired days, sleep tips that work or don't.
topics.health:running: Running training, half marathon goal (München Halbmarathon, October).
topics.health:knee: Knee pain from running in February, physio (Lea helps), slow return.
topics.health:burnout: Feeling empty, exhausted, close to burnout in April.
topics.home:heating: The broken heating in the Giesing flat in November and December, cold rooms, landlord.
topics.home:moving: Flat hunting, viewings, moving in with Lea, packing, the move in July.
topics.home:balcony-plants: Tomatoes, basil and chilli on the new balcony.
topics.money:taxes: Doing the tax return (Steuererklärung) in May, receipts, Elster, the refund.
topics.money:worries: Money worries: rent, savings, the cost of the move.
topics.feeling:anxiety: Anxiety about the future, worrying, racing thoughts.
topics.feeling:loneliness: Feeling alone, even with people around.
topics.feeling:anger: Being angry or frustrated at someone or something.
topics.hobby:guitar: Learning guitar from April on, chords, a teacher, first song.
topics.hobby:cooking: Cooking at home, recipes, cooking for Lea, Sunday soup.
topics.hobby:reading: Books he reads and what he thinks about them.
topics.event:christmas: Christmas 2025 in Regensburg with Mama, Anna and Oma (in hospital).
topics.event:half-marathon: The half marathon race day in October.
topics.event:baby-mila: Anna's daughter Mila is born in October; Kai becomes an uncle.
topics.dream: He tells a dream he had.

never_mention: football (soccer) matches beyond Tobi watching them is allowed; never American football

timeline.beats: Heating breaks in the Giesing flat, cold, fights with landlord Herr Kraus. Launch prep starts at Nordwerk. Starts running at the Isar. Lea and Kai happy, a few dates. First bad nights.
Oma falls and goes to hospital. Christmas in Regensburg, visiting Oma. Heating finally fixed after New Year. Sleep problems get worse. New year thoughts, a dream or two.
Launch crunch, Sven pushes hard, a tense talk. Knee pain from running, Lea (physio) helps. First sessions with Dr. Weber. Anxiety. Launch day March 10.
After the launch: emptiness, close to burnout, time off. Starts guitar lessons. A fight with Lea about moving in together, then they decide to look for a flat. Oma in rehab.
Tax return (Steuererklärung) with Elster. Flat viewings, they get the Haidhausen flat. Money worries about deposit and move. Running again carefully. Evenings at the Isar. Reading.
Packing and moving (early July). Holiday in Lisbon with Lea. Anna tells she is pregnant. Balcony plants. Gratitude.
Salary negotiation with Sven, goes OK. Tobi's 35th birthday party. Hike in the Alps. Worries about AI and his job. Half marathon training gets serious.
Half marathon race day (October 11). Anna's baby Mila born (October 20), Kai visits Regensburg. Reflections on the year, gratitude, some loneliness, a dream.
